description: Search background music tracks. Write query in English, such as "calm piano" or "upbeat corporate"; Vietnamese and other languages give poor matches, so translate first. genre narrows the search, for example "intro outro", and can be used without a query. duration is one of the length ranges 0-30, 30-120, 120-240 or 240-480 seconds; pick the one that holds the length the edit needs. Each result has a direct mp3_url, the author, duration_seconds and two flags from the source: has_youtube_content_id (a YouTube upload may get a Content ID claim; tell the user) and is_ai_generated. 20 results per page; raise page for more.

genre.description: Optional genre, such as intro outro

query.description: English words for the mood, style or use

name: search_music
